title: Paper Garden
constraints: single HTML file if html stack, single component if vite

workerResult.summary: Paper Garden — fold origami flora that blooms on click. Fold engine folds each bloom live on canvas (petals open from crease lines on tap, ease-out-back bloom, paper-rustle + plucked koto via WebAudio); bloom garden plants seeded flowers on the paper with stems, leaves, washi palette, fold shading, sway, and soft cast shadow under a hand-drawn ensō. Seed sharing: whole garden encodes to a #g= share link, single seeds paste or load via #s=, all deterministic and persisted in localStorage. Day/night mode brings fireflies out at night; sakura petal-storm easter egg; keyboard shortcuts throughout. Verified at 1440px and 375px with zero console errors and no horizontal overflow; share-link round-trip restores exact blooms.
